question: How can you set up the supply source for the Kanban process in SAP S/4HANA Cloud Private Edition? (Choose three.) A. Use purchase orders for external procurement. B. Use stock transfer reservations for stock transfer. C. Use quotations for internal and external procurement. D. Use run schedule quantities for in-house production. E. question: Your production planners are allowed to execute planning only for specific resources. How can you achieve this in Advanced Planning (PP/DS)? A. Use a planning area. B. Use a resource group. C. Use a planning group. D. Use a propagation range.
discussion: Selected Answer: A In PP/DS, **Planning Area** is a permission control function that defines the scope of materials, resources, plants, etc., and restricts a specific worker to perform planning only for resources included in the area. Officially, this function is provided and is a permission-based planning restriction method. upvoted 1 time Submit Cancel

question: How would you define pegging in the context of Advanced Planning? A. An evaluation that is ordered according to the network structure of all related products and represents the coverage of issue elements with receipt elements and stock B. An evaluation that is ordered according to the bill-of-material structure of all related products and represents the relationship between the receipt and the issue elements C. An evaluation to identify overstock situations in the balance between the receipt and the issue elements after the production planning run D. An evaluation to identify material or capacity shortages in the bill-of-material structure after the production planning run
discussion: Selected Answer: A According to the official SAP PP/DS documentation, Pegging is converted to a network-based structure. Map the issue element (issue element) with the traveler element (receipt element) and inventory (inventory). upvoted 1 time Submit Cancel
